title: Red panda wearing sunglasses
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- ears -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='26' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#c1440e'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='26' rx='11' ry='12' fill='#c1440e'/>
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='26' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <ellipse cx='74' cy='26' rx='6' ry='7' fill='#f5e6d3'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='48' rx='30' ry='26' fill='#d9531e'/>
  <!-- cheek fluff -->
  <ellipse cx='24' cy='54' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#f2e8dc'/>
  <ellipse cx='76' cy='54' rx='9' ry='8' fill='#f2e8dc'/>
  <!-- face patch -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='56' rx='20' ry='16' fill='#f7f0e6'/>
  <!-- muzzle -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='66' rx='9' ry='6' fill='#ffe6c9'/>
  <!-- nose -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='4' ry='3' fill='#3a2a1a'/>
  <!-- white eyebrows patches -->
  <ellipse cx='36' cy='38' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f7f0e6'/>
  <ellipse cx='64' cy='38' rx='8' ry='5' fill='#f7f0e6'/>

  <rect x='44' y='42' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2e3440'/>
  <!-- sunglasses lenses -->
  <rect x='26' y='36' width='20' height='13' rx='5' fill='#2e3440'/>
  <rect x='54' y='36' width='20' height='13' rx='5' fill='#2e3440'/>
  <!-- lens shine -->
  <rect x='30' y='39' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7f96b5'/>
  <rect x='58' y='39' width='6' height='4' rx='2' fill='#7f96b5'/>
  <!-- arms of glasses -->
  <rect x='16' y='40' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2e3440'/>
  <rect x='72' y='40' width='12' height='3' rx='1.5' fill='#2e3440'/>
  <!-- mouth -->
  <path d='M46 70 Q50 74 54 70' stroke='#8a4b2a' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- stripes on head -->
  <rect x='43' y='24' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#a83a10'/>
  <rect x='53' y='24' width='4' height='8' rx='2' fill='#a83a10'/>
</svg>
